thread:
sara_cs: FYI, Atlas Finance escalation — they say answers are now confidently wrong after our routing change. examples below, they reported 5 incidents in the last 48h. @jordan_research @lee_sre please triage. :exclamation:

sara_cs: Customer example pasted: 
> Prompt: "What's the current variable APR for product X and which policy governs it?"
> Model reply: "Variable APR for Product X is 4.75% under policy PD-4590. See section 4.2 of PD-4590 for limits."
Customer: both the APR and policy id are fabricated — their internal data shows 6.1% and policy is PD-3120. They attached request_id: rq_20260315_0a1b2c.

deploy-bot: rollout event: routing-profile swap "cost-first" -> "cost-first-with-latency-fallback", rw-infer-2.6, rollout 60% @ 2026-03-15T22:14:05Z.

jordan_research: thx — can we get the raw prompt+response and the exact request_id(s)? Also which model variant (rw-infer-2.6/quantized?) and sequence length? any temperature overrides? :thinking:

emily_cs: attaching the snippet from Atlas support (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rw-infer-2.6",
  "input": "What's the current variable APR for Product X and which policy governs it?",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 120
}
Response (truncated):
"Variable APR for Product X is 4.75% under policy PD-4590. See section 4.2 of PD-4590 for limits."
request_id: rq_20260315_0a1b2c
latency: 420ms
```

emily_cs: they also provided 4 other request_ids, all same pattern: wrong numeric answers or wrong policy ids.

lee_sre: grabbing logs for rq_20260315_0a1b2c now. any sign of 500s or timeout retries? latency looks normal.

lee_sre: log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T22:14:05Z] rq=rq_20260315_0a1b2c model=rw-infer-2.6 route=cost-first cpu=low gpu=engaged kv_cache_hit=false seq=48
[2026-03-15T22:14:05Z] policy_selected=cost-first fallback_latency_threshold_ms=300 used_fallback=false
```

matt_prod: we flipped that routing-profile at 22:14 and increased to 60% traffic. no other model weight changes. we did enable a small "response_trimming" tweak in runtime config at 22:10 but that should only affect truncation. rolling back routing swap to 30% now for the affected tenant set as an immediate mitigation.

jordan_research: interesting that temperature=0.0 and seq short. possible explanation: the model is overconfident after prefix-merging change or we accidentally swapped knowledge-enabled variant? any kernel/quantization changes deployed recently?

emily_cs: Atlas says when they repro'd against rw-infer-2.5 (pinned) the answer matched their internal data. so rollback/pin is a viable mitigation.

jordan_research: steps for triage: 1) compare generation traces (logits/beam probs if available) between rw-infer-2.5 and rw-infer-2.6 for the same prompt; 2) check any recent changes to prefix caching/kv merge logic; 3) run batch of Atlas test prompts across 2.5/2.6 with deterministic seeds; 4) if repro consistent, prepare hotfix to routing or rollback variant.

lee_sre: grabbing more traces now — will attach links. also asking infra to snapshot the 2.6 runtime config for 22:00-22:20 window.

emily_cs: Atlas asked for ETA and mitigation; told them we pinned their workspace to rw-infer-2.5 and opened a private support ticket. they confirmed reduced failures after pin. :thumbsup:

sara_cs: action items: Jordan + Lee investigate traces and kv-cache/prefix changes. Matt to keep routing at reduced exposure for affected customers. Emily to continue support comms. tagging #eng-runtime for visibility.

jordan_research: noted. I'll start with deterministic reruns and post short repro matrix here by EOD. :eyes:
